messages.subject: rapache-latest.tar.gz not found
parts:
Hello everyone,

I am installing rApache on my ubuntu. Thw following wget command fails
because it is not able to find the source on vanderbilt.edu website.
Can anyone help me with another source of this file or direct me to a
person who could provide me this file to install rApache.


~$ wget http://biostat.mc.vanderbilt.edu/rapache/files/rapache-latest.tar.gz
--2012-03-11 17:12:55-- http://biostat.mc.vanderbilt.edu/rapache/files/rapache-latest.tar.gz
Resolving biostat.mc.vanderbilt.edu... 160.129.116.197
Connecting to biostat.mc.vanderbilt.edu|160.129.116.197|:80...
connected.
HTTP request sent, awaiting response... 404 Not Found
2012-03-11 17:13:01 ERROR 404: Not Found.


Thanks in advance.

Regards
Aman
